dimensions.assessment: Directly affects qualified youth or conservation corps carrying out conservation projects and federal agencies administering the Public Lands Corps Act of 1993.
dimensions.evidence: conservation projects carried out by a qualified youth or conservation corps

dimensions.assessment: Modifies the statutory cost-share ratio for project funding, altering the local matching burden for participating organizations.
dimensions.evidence: by striking '75' and inserting '90'; and... by striking '25' and inserting '10'.

dimensions.assessment: Increases the maximum potential federal share of project costs from 75 percent to 90 percent, potentially increasing federal expenditure per project depending on total allocations.
Makes a narrow numerical amendment to an existing statute governing public lands conservation projects.
dimensions.evidence: Section 212(a)(1) of the Public Lands Corps Act of 1993 (16 U.S.C. 1729(a)(1)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently as an amendment to the underlying statute governing future and ongoing projects.

missing_information: Total aggregate federal funding authorizations or estimates of overall cost changes.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies cost-sharing requirements for conservation projects carried out by qualified youth or conservation corps by changing the federal share from 75 percent to 90 percent and the non-federal share from 25 percent to 10 percent.
